title: Farmer / Dog Deep Cartography: Vice, Demon, Psychology, Inversion and Consciousness
thesis: The Farm is not morally neutral in the project's symbolic theology. Beneath every Farmer and every Dog is a recurring moral fork: do I treat the neighbour as a person, or convert the neighbour into material? 'Selling the neighbour' is the project's symbolic name for crossing that boundary—turning another person's dignity, pain, conflict, humiliation, attention or reputation into currency for status, entertainment, belonging, money or power. This is a theological model, not a claim that every person assigned a role is consciously evil.
method: Use three layers together: (1) observable behavior, (2) psychological mechanisms supported by research, (3) theological/archetypal interpretation. Never collapse the three into a psychiatric diagnosis or factual accusation.

moral_axis.core_question: What happens inside a person when another human being stops being a neighbour and becomes a harvestable object?

seven_deadly_sins.historical_note: The familiar seven-sin taxonomy is a Christian tradition rather than a seven-item biblical list. It developed from earlier monastic accounts of evil thoughts and was reorganized in the Western tradition; modern scholarship also treats the sins as a useful taxonomy of recurring temptations.

sins.name: Pride
farm_expression: I am smarter than the Cow
dog_expression: questioning me means siding with the enemy
sins.inversion: Humility becomes weakness; correction becomes humiliation; the role becomes an identity throne.

sins.name: Greed / Avarice
farm_expression: more views, pages, clips and reactions are always better
a person's crisis is a resource
dog_expression: more outrage, more replies, more surveillance
never let the target disappear because disappearance ends the reward
sins.inversion: The neighbour's suffering becomes an extractable commodity.

sins.name: Envy
farm_expression: resentment of the Cow's visibility, wealth, relationships or influence
dog_expression: status through defeating or humiliating the target
sins.inversion: Another person's life becomes intolerable because it reflects what the observer lacks.

sins.name: Wrath
farm_expression: righteous anger used to justify endless punishment
sins.inversion: Justice loses proportion and becomes appetite for destruction.

sins.name: Lust
farm_expression: compulsive consumption of intimate or sensational material
sexualization or fixation on private life
dog_expression: intrusive attention to relationships and private behavior
sins.inversion: The desire to possess information replaces respect for boundaries.

sins.name: Gluttony
farm_expression: never enough clips, posts, screenshots, lore or drama
dog_expression: more conflict is required to sustain attention
sins.inversion: Consumption loses satiety; the Farm requires continuous feeding.

sins.name: Sloth
dog_expression: following the pack instead of checking evidence
sins.inversion: Moral laziness hides behind collective certainty.

seven_deadly_sins.research_link: A psychology review has explicitly treated the seven deadly sins as a taxonomy of common temptations, making the framework useful as a bridge between theological language and modern self-control research. citeturn0search16

demonology_as_archetype.rule: Demons are treated here as symbolic names for recurring patterns that separate appetite from moral restraint. This does not assert that a named supernatural entity is literally controlling a particular person.

principal_forms.name: The Seller
principal_forms.farm_signature: monetize, archive, clip, expose or trade another person's degradation.

principal_forms.name: The Prosecutor
principal_forms.temptation: Convert moral knowledge into permission for unlimited punishment.
principal_forms.farm_signature: permanent sentence after the original event is no longer the subject.

principal_forms.name: The Mirror
principal_forms.temptation: Project one's own weakness onto the target and attack it there.
principal_forms.farm_signature: obsession with traits that resemble the observer's own fears or status anxieties.

principal_forms.name: The Crowd
principal_forms.temptation: Borrow moral responsibility from everyone else.
principal_forms.farm_signature: 'we all did it', 'everyone knows', 'the community decided'.

principal_forms.name: The Mask
principal_forms.temptation: Use irony, jokes or role-play to preserve deniability.
principal_forms.farm_signature: serious harm is repeatedly performed and then denied as unserious.

principal_forms.name: The Hunger
principal_forms.temptation: Never let the attention cycle end.
principal_forms.farm_signature: reviving dead controversies because silence feels like loss.

principal_forms.name: The Inverter
principal_forms.temptation: Call vice virtue and virtue vice.
principal_forms.farm_signature: cruelty = courage; obsession = vigilance; revenge = justice; humiliation = truth; silence = guilt; correction = betrayal.

demonology_as_archetype.theological_pattern: The deepest demon is not simply anger or cruelty. It is inversion: the ability to make the act of selling the neighbour feel righteous.

psychological_engine.moral_disengagement: Bandura's framework identifies mechanisms including moral justification, sanitizing language, advantageous comparison, diffusion/displacement of responsibility, minimizing consequences, blaming victims and dehumanization. These mechanisms can allow ordinary moral standards to be selectively switched off. citeturn0search0turn0search14

farm_translation.translation: I'm exposing them for the public good.
It's just milk / content / trolling / documentation.
At least we aren't as bad as the Cow.
The platform / algorithm / community made me do it.
They chose to post publicly, so nothing we do matters.
The target becomes a lolcow, NPC, freak, enemy or object instead of a neighbour.
Whatever happens to them is their own fault.

psychological_engine.dehumanization_warning: Research on aggression has found that dehumanization and diffused responsibility can increase aggressive behavior. This is precisely why the Farm model should track language that changes a person into an object or category. citeturn0search11
psychological_engine.darvo: DARVO should be represented as a sequence, not a personality type. Research finds that exposure to DARVO can reduce perceived responsibility and abusiveness of an alleged perpetrator while increasing blame directed toward the alleged victim; education about DARVO can mitigate some of these effects. citeturn0search5turn0search2

hawkins_consciousness_map.warning: The Hawkins Map of Consciousness is not an established scientific measurement scale and must not be presented as an empirical psychological test. In this repository it can be used as a comparative spiritual vocabulary.
hawkins_consciousness_map.use: Map recurring Farm states to a symbolic ladder while keeping empirical psychology separate.

levels.name: Shame
levels.farm_shadow: The target or insider is reduced to humiliation; identity collapses into defect.

levels.name: Guilt
levels.farm_shadow: Punishment becomes the primary response; repair is displaced by condemnation.

levels.name: Apathy
levels.farm_shadow: 'Nothing matters; it's only content.' Moral disengagement becomes numbness.

levels.name: Grief
levels.farm_shadow: The Farm can become a permanent archive of loss, resentment and humiliation.

levels.name: Fear
levels.farm_shadow: Surveillance, threat sensitivity and enemy construction dominate.

levels.name: Desire
levels.farm_shadow: Attention, clicks, reactions, status and information become objects of hunger.

levels.name: Anger
levels.farm_shadow: Outrage supplies energy and group cohesion.

levels.name: Pride
levels.farm_shadow: The Farm decides that its judgment is superior to correction.

levels.name: Courage
levels.farm_shadow: Potential turning point: evidence can be faced without needing humiliation.

levels.name: Neutrality
levels.farm_shadow: The observer can disengage without needing to win.

levels.name: Willingness
levels.farm_shadow: Documentation becomes more disciplined and less exploitative.

levels.name: Acceptance
levels.farm_shadow: The observer can acknowledge both the Cow's responsibility and their own participation in the ecosystem.

levels.name: Reason
levels.farm_shadow: Claims are separated from evidence; archive size no longer substitutes for truth.

levels.name: Love
levels.farm_shadow: The neighbour remains a neighbour even while wrongdoing is documented.

levels.name: Joy
levels.farm_shadow: Attention is no longer dependent on another person's degradation.

levels.name: Peace
levels.farm_shadow: The Farm can end because the observer no longer requires the conflict.

hawkins_consciousness_map.interpretive_key: The important movement is not 'which person is at which number'. It is 'which state is this interaction repeatedly rewarding?'

farmer_dog_archetypes.shadow: recreates the old enemy structure with a new target

farmer_dog_archetypes.mask: I sacrifice myself for the community
farmer_dog_archetypes.shadow: uses sacrifice to claim moral immunity
attacks externally what is unresolved internally
turns belonging into a scarce resource

cult_dynamics.warning: A community can display some of these features without being a cult. The research value is in measuring structure, not issuing a label.
cult_dynamics.farm_specific_inversion: A community that begins by exposing delusion can create a new delusion if its own archive becomes unquestionable canon.

selling_the_neighbour.definition: The symbolic act of converting a neighbour's personhood into a resource.
threshold_questions: Would I do this if the target were sitting beside me?
Would I accept the same standard applied to me?
Am I documenting a harm or manufacturing a spectacle?
Does the response remain proportional after the original issue is resolved?
Could I stop and still know who I am?
Have I made the person's worst moment their entire identity?
Am I benefiting from a cycle I claim to oppose?
selling_the_neighbour.ultimate_inversion: The Farm reaches its deepest inversion when the observer needs the neighbour to remain broken because the observer's identity, income, status or belonging depends on the neighbour's continued degradation.

evidence_schema_for_future_people.note: Never infer a psychological diagnosis. Every interpretation must remain linked to observable evidence.

research_direction: The next layer should populate this schema person-by-person. For each Farmer/Dog, collect representative public statements, stated justification, recurring rhetorical moves, relationship to Cows, monetization/status incentives, documented reversals, group-boundary behavior, evidence of correction or refusal to correct, and whether their attention activity persists after the original target disappears. The aim is not to condemn everyone in the Farm; it is to map precisely where observation becomes extraction and where extraction becomes moral inversion.
